mechanism.claim: When a completed BTC perpetual eight-hour cycle closes in the directional outer 35 percent of its exact high-low range, realized variation is elevated, and open interest contracts, the directional close is liquidation-driven without fresh leveraged sponsorship and should reverse over eight hours.
mechanism.side: opposite strict sign of the completed eight-hour BTC perpetual return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCCLOICR requires an exact completed-range close location with exact OI contraction and variation. No prior composite event set or control is reused; it uses no spot, ETH, funding, premium-index, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour close-location plus OI-contraction exhaustion states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, each exchange-timestamped no later than D
features.close_location: (final completed one-minute close-cycle_low)/(cycle_high-cycle_low), finite with strict positive exact completed-cycle range
features.close_location_confirmation: close_location>0.65 for positive completed_return or close_location<0.35 for negative completed_return
features.completed_return: sum of 480 one-minute log(close/open) returns, finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [D-8h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact coherent 480-row OHLC cycle, nonzero completed return, directional outer-35-percent completed-range close location, two exact OI endpoints with strict contraction, and the variation rank passes at D; no taker-flow sign, spot source, funding, premium-index, alt, or post-decision condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or contraction rule, close-location confirmation, variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
